verdict.rationale: Salv documents per-field matching configuration: fuzzy name matching with a user-set threshold, or exact matching for identifiers. It also normalises entries and transliterates Cyrillic, Greek and Chinese (Traditional), and AI-Powered Insights explains its reasoning on a name match, which gives analysts a way to inspect matches. missing for 10: explicit alias/AKA matching support, detail on how transliterated or alias matches are shown in the alert view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can configure name matching and inspect alias or transliteration matches

citations.quote: Choose matching per field: fuzzy for names, where spelling varies, with a threshold you set; exact for an account number
Entries are normalised and cleaned first, and transliteration covers Cyrillic, Greek and Chinese (Traditional).
AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning
